glosses: Something or someone that sticks (pierces, or adheres).

examples.text: […] and I said to Mr. McCauley, whatever is the matter with your neck, it is all swelled up, and he said he got it in the mill; he said he had an arm load of wool and a sticker stuck him in the neck, here (indicating the right hand side of the neck just below the jaw).

The prisoner fell flat on his face. They dragged him again, this time towards the grove of calafates. They lifted him up there and they threw him in the middle of the bushes. The boy screamed. Thousands of stickers pierced into his flesh.

When the prickly pear stickers pierced their paws they howled with pain, but they kept running. Sinopa, who hated the fighting, had followed her brothers. She shot a magic arrow over their heads, which pushed the brothers to safety, […]
He toppled backward, landing on a particularly large cholla and crying out as hundreds of stickers pierced his flesh.

glosses: One who sticks to something, or does not give up; a stayer.

examples.text: He's a sticker. He was a goer to the end in all he did — and in Rugger outstandingly […]

glosses: An adhesive label or decal.
A price tag.
The listed price (also sticker price).

examples.text: When buying a car, know the sticker and the invoice price.

glosses: A cartoonish illustration of a character that represents an emotion or action, often accompanied by text, that may be superimposed on a digital image.
A burr or seed pod that catches in fur or clothing.
That which causes one to stick; that which puzzles or poses.

examples.text: "That's what I call a sticker for Wagg!"

glosses: A wooden strip placed between courses of lumber to allow air circulation and to create a gap so the unit can be picked up with a forklift (also kiln sticker).
A small wooden rod in an organ which connects (in part) a key and a pallet, so as to communicate motion by pushing.
A brand, label, or company, especially one making and distributing records.
A paster.
A bayonet.
To apply one or more stickers to (something).

examples.text: A tattooed camp staffer DJs from a heavily stickered laptop, next to a whirling party light that scatters rainbow beams throughout the space.

glosses: To mark as the sticker price

examples.text: Also out of Africa: a huge hammered copper floor mirror stickered at $449.

glosses: kus papíru či plastové fólie, z jedné strany opatřený lepicí vrstvou, jehož druhá strana je určená pro textové či grafické informace

examples.text: Obloučké a miminkovsky zkarikované tvary, velké oči, jásavá modrá barva. Ale co naplat, v osmdesátých letech to byla velká pecka. Frčely žvýkačkové nálepky, trička, vlastně všechno. Zatímco na Západě Šmoulové okupovali veřejný prostor díky kromobyčejně úspěšnému seriálu už od začátku osmdesátých let, v československé televizi se objevili až koncem dekády.

glosses: zjednodušené označení osoby, názoru či jevu na základě povrchního dojmu či předsudku

examples.text: I pokud (…) případ [Sereny Williamsové] bude mít pozitivní vliv na to, že soudcování v tenise bude férovější, neznamená to, že ona je pozitivní hrdinkou boje za práva žen. Naopak dala veřejnosti obrovskou munici k tomu, aby byli přesvědčeni, že cokoli s nálepkou „feministické“ je zároveň agresivní a hysterické.

Na jedné straně mají úspěch takzvaní populisté. To je hloupá nálepka, spíš plivanec, než označení s jasnou výpovědní hodnotou. Jde o politické formace, které odpovídají na to, o čem tuší, že si lidé přejí a vycházejí tomu vstříc. Oproti tomu progresisté (i to je floskule a nálepka) vědí, co je správné, a hloupému publiku se to snaží vnutit.
